messages.author: 4e6060fd7b80ee80
messages.subject: Install RSNNS on Amazon EC2
parts:
Hey Guys,

My shiny app is trying to load the RSNNS package. So I was trying to install this package on Amazon EC2. This is what I have done:


2013-12-07 04:01:39 (501 KB/s) - `RSNNS_0.4-3.tar.gz' saved [949514/949514]

ubuntu@ip-172-xx-x-xx:~$ sudo R CMD INSTALL RSNNS_0.4-3.tar.gz.

Then Amazon EC2 returns:

  • installing to library ‘/usr/local/lib/R/site-library’

  • installing source package ‘RSNNS’ ... ** package ‘RSNNS’ successfully unpacked and MD5 sums checked ** libs g++ -I/usr/share/R/include -DNDEBUG -I"/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/Rcpp/include" -fpic -O3 -pipe -g -c SnnsCLib.cpp -o SnnsCLib.o gcc -std=gnu99 -I/usr/share/R/include -DNDEBUG -I"/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/Rcpp/include" -fpic -O3 -pipe -g -c SnnsCLibGenericR_util.c -o SnnsCLibGenericR_util.o g++ -I/usr/share/R/include -DNDEBUG -I"/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/Rcpp/include" -fpic -O3 -pipe -g -c SnnsCLibWrapper.cpp -o SnnsCLibWrapper.o g++: internal compiler error: Killed (program cc1plus) Please submit a full bug report, with preprocessed source if appropriate. See for instructions. make: * [SnnsCLibWrapper.o] Error 4 ERROR: compilation failed for package ‘RSNNS’

  • removing ‘/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/RSNNS’

I have no problem of installing other R packages on Amazon EC2 or install the RSNNS package on my local Ubuntu system. Anyone knows why this took place and how to resolve it?

Thank you,

Su
